body:
The weekly SEO monitor failed on Node 20 at its first TypeScript command (`node: bad option: --experimental-strip-types`), skipping ten later checks. Latest original failure: [41438214991](https://github.com/rushal0803/socialrush-panel/actions/runs/41438214991).

Use Node 24 LTS, run independent checks unless cancelled, and retain each check's logs for 14 days. Bash pipefail preserves failure status through tee. Recovering the full workflow exposed an over-escaped schema matcher: it falsely rejected valid Service/BlogPosting JSON-LD on twelve pages. Parse actual JSON-LD blocks, including graphs and array types, with behavioral regressions rejecting malformed and unrelated text.

Validation on final head `94a0c1a5754faef41aeb1408fc9604c1727caab7`:

- Vercel `dpl_GQ2V2bUCUFGucKspfS2qZNAyNJAC`: READY at the exact head, preview target only. Authenticated GET of [Instagram Followers preview](https://socialrush-panel-74qtz0b8n-rushalthakur240-6255s-projects.vercel.app/buy-instagram-followers-india) returned 200 with expected title, one H1 and production canonical. Hosted mobile visual QA is not claimed.

[Implementation evidence and performance triage](https://github.com/rushal0803/socialrush-panel/blob/fix/seo-monitor-runtime-20261108/docs/seo-monitor-runtime-20261108.md).

Current execution batch:

| Field | Result |
|---|---|
| Sprint | A verification, B performance diagnosis, D discovery verification, F monitor repair |
| Scope | PRs #744–#747; 172 sitemap pages, eight discovered non-sitemap pages; five priority preview pages; first-party analytics; weekly workflow |
| Confirmed issues | Node runtime prevented complete monitoring; malformed checker regex produced false missing-schema alerts. Attribution contamination persists in historical/current production data; source fix #745 remains unmerged. |
| Fixes | Node 24, independent execution, retained logs, parsed JSON-LD, two behavioral regression tests |
| Tests | Monitor and local checks pass; full PR build/browser/customer-fixture workflow passes; optional visual/performance jobs skipped |
| GitHub | This separate draft branch; existing #744–#747 remain draft/unmerged |
| Vercel | Exact-head preview READY, authenticated HTML verified; no production deployment |
| SEO impact | Monitoring executes all checks and correctly recognizes valid JSON-LD. No ranking, indexing, citation or revenue uplift claimed. |
| Production | No production changes, database mutations, orders or payments |
| Blockers | Search Console connector requires subscription; no saved first-party GSC export/table found. Required-check configuration returns GitHub 403. Protected hosted mobile visual review remains outstanding. |
| Next | Review the verified draft release candidates; obtain free GSC exports for demand/indexing and trace the unreproduced Instagram field INP miss |

Inventory and measurement status:
- All 69 previously inventoried service/platform URLs reconciled to the live crawl: HTTP 200 and no noindex. No service-page copy changed in this monitoring PR; all 69 remain pending comprehensive page-level optimization. Five priority pages received fresh protected-preview HTML and public mobile checks.
- Discovery crawl fetched 180 pages (172 sitemap + eight additional). Five catalog-only TikTok routes and three auth pages are noindex. Unknown-path probe returns HTTP 404. Homepage-reachable HTML graph still misses Partners, Press and Growth Planner; existing #746/#747 supplies the proposed footer links. Duplicate BreadcrumbList trails remain a review item on production LinkedIn and Facebook Shares; #747 preview LinkedIn emits one trail.
- Google/Bing indexing known: zero of 69; unknown: 69. No current AI citation evidence. Robot access/AEO checks pass, which does not prove retrieval or citation.
- Stored current-release mobile service-detail navigate cohort: LCP p75 2292ms (970 events), TTFB 978.5ms (1026), INP 192ms (566), CLS 0.0002 (819). Instagram Followers INP is 208ms (137). These are stored first-party event cohorts, not a verified CrUX pass or causal before/after comparison.
- Public mobile lab: 3 cold-context trials/page at 390x844, 150ms latency, 1.6Mbps down, 4x CPU. Median LCP: Instagram Followers 3472ms; Instagram Likes 3492ms; YouTube Subscribers 2544ms; YouTube Views 3480ms; LinkedIn Followers 2208ms. All 15 returned 200 with one H1, canonical, no document overflow and CLS 0 during the observation window. DNT and non-read-request blocking enabled; managed proxy influences timings. No performance improvement claimed.
- Five read-only quantity-input/stepper trials reproduced correct quantity state and 40–64ms observed interaction duration at 4x CPU; this does not reproduce or rule out the field INP issue.
- Organic conversion measurement is not ready: last-28-day organic_landing_view has 6483 events versus 4728 distinct session IDs, including direct, Google-auth and Vercel referrals. These counts are not validated organic sessions or revenue. No historical events were rewritten.
- digispeed.in currently presents a digital marketing/web development/training agency. Its homepage is not verified as matching service-package purchase intent; no ranking, volume or competitor-traffic claims.

No application, database, checkout, payment, catalog, production deployment or crawler-policy changes. Separate from existing foundation draft #747.
